title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. Expands Lodging Portfolio with Purchase of Hyatt Key West Resort and Spa
summary: Inland American Lodging Group, Inc. (Inland American), a wholly owned subsidiary of Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc., and Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H), today announced that Inland American has purchased Hyatt Key West Resort and Spa in Key West, Fla., from a Hyatt affiliate for a purchase price of approximately $76 million. The resort, located in the heart of Key West on the Gulf of Mexico, will continue to be managed by Hyatt under a new management agreement. Hyatt Key West Resort and Spa (Photo: Business Wire) "We are extremely pleased to have added Hyatt Key West Resort and Spa to our portfolio, said Marcel Verbaas, president and CEO of Inland American Lodging Advisor, Inc.
